logline: 가슴에 표식을 달고 사는 여자가 그것을 숨기지 않는 동안, 표식이 없는 한 사람이 무너져 간다.
destination: 장터 한복판의 처형대 — 그녀가 처음 섰던 자리
setting: 17세기 뉴잉글랜드 청교도 마을, 장터와 감옥과 숲
anchor: a young woman in a plain grey gown with a red embroidered patch on her breast, dark hair covered
palette: cold New England daylight, weathered timber brown, deep forest green, single scarlet accent

beats.beat: 젊은 여자가 아기를 안고 감옥 문을 나선다.
beats.visual: a young woman holding an infant stepping out of a heavy timber prison door into harsh daylight
beats.motion: the door swings back, she squints into the light, the infant stirs

beats.beat: 장터 처형대 위에 그녀가 홀로 선다.
beats.visual: a young woman standing alone on a raised wooden platform above a silent crowd in a village square
beats.motion: the crowd shifts below her, her chin lifts, wind pulls at her skirt

beats.beat: 군중 속 낯선 남자가 그녀를 오래 응시한다.
beats.visual: a stooped older man at the edge of a crowd staring upward, face half shadowed by a wide hat
beats.motion: his fingers curl at his side, the crowd moves around him, his stare holds

beats.beat: 그녀는 가슴의 붉은 표식을 가리지 않는다.
beats.visual: a young woman's hands folded low, a red embroidered patch plainly visible on her grey bodice
beats.motion: her hands stay down, the patch catches light, her breathing steadies

beats.visual: a small girl in red running between tall dark trees, a woman watching from a mossy clearing
beats.motion: the child darts between trunks, leaves scatter, sunlight breaks through branches

beats.beat: 젊은 목사가 밤마다 제 가슴을 눌러 본다.
beats.visual: a pale young clergyman alone in a dim study pressing one hand flat against his chest
beats.motion: his hand presses and releases, the candle leans, sweat shines on his brow

beats.beat: 그가 그 처형대에 오른다면 무슨 말을 할까?
beats.visual: a wooden platform empty above a gathering crowd, a pale clergyman approaching its steps
beats.motion: the crowd presses inward, his foot finds the first step, banners of cloud move fast

beats.beat: 빈 처형대 위로 저녁 빛이 내린다.
beats.visual: evening light falling on an empty raised wooden platform in a deserted village square
beats.motion: light slides across the boards, dust lifts, a rope sways at the post

withheld: 목사가 스스로 가슴을 드러내는 마지막 대목과 추적자의 정체
